video_conditions: SoccerNet research use only; no redistribution or commercial use. Public ungated GSR archive, no NDA acceptance performed. Code/data-card license is not a commercial video-rights grant.
scope: Training archive directory audit, then first lexicographic training clip's first 25 JPEG frames and its supplied metadata/labels. No validation/test/challenge content.
selection: Deterministic first training sequence, not selected for detector success. Existing detector settings unchanged. Initial run is pipeline smoke test and descriptive coverage, not model selection or independent test.
split_policy: Do not infer independent matches from clip IDs. Resolve shared source matches before any calibration/validation split or claims of generalization.
final_goal: Image measurement layer, independently checked identity/calibration/time, then guarded fusion with tracking; supplied-match manual corrections never training inputs.
